faces.name: The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
faces.oracleText: All creatures have "At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy this creature unless you pay {1}."

faces.name: The Tale of Jimothy
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
The Tale of Jimothy can be your commander. If it is, Jimothy is also your commander.
I — Create Jimothy, a legendary 2/1 green Raccoon with "Whenever a card is put into your graveyard from your library, put a +1/+1 counter on Jimothy."
II, III — Surveil 1.

faces.name: The Tale of Tamiyo
faces.oracleText:
(As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after IV.)
I, II, III — Mill two cards. If two cards that share a card type were milled this way, draw a card and repeat this process.
IV — Exile any number of target instant, sorcery, and/or Tamiyo planeswalker cards from your graveyard. Copy them. You may cast any number of the copies.

faces.name: The Tarrasque
faces.oracleText:
The Tarrasque has haste and ward {10} as long as it was cast.
Whenever The Tarrasque attacks, it fights target creature defending player controls.

faces.name: The Temporal Anchor
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of your upkeep, scry 2.
Whenever you choose to put one or more cards on the bottom of your library while scrying, exile that many cards from the bottom of your library.
During your turn, you may play cards exiled with The Temporal Anchor.

faces.name: The Ten Rings
faces.oracleText:
Your maximum hand size is ten.
At the beginning of your end step, if you have fewer than ten cards in hand, draw cards equal to the difference.

faces.name: The Tenth Doctor
faces.oracleText:
Allons-y! — Whenever you attack, exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card. Put three time counters on it. If it doesn't have suspend, it gains suspend.
Timey-Wimey — {7}: Time travel three times. Activate only as a sorcery. (For each suspended card you own and each permanent you control with a time counter on it, you may add or remove a time counter. Then do it two more times.)

faces.name: The Terror of Serpent's Pass
faces.oracleText: Hexproof (This creature can't be the target of spells or abilities your opponents control.)
